page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 4 dedicated physical cores with 4 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The KVM-hypervised instance allocates dedicated CPU resources, ensuring consistent compute performance without virtualization-induced resource sharing. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage and a relatively low baseline network speed of 2 Gbps, which may limit data-intensive transfer operations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge offers an entry-level GPU acceleration profile by pairing a legacy NVIDIA P4 GPU with a modest 4-vCPU allocation. This resource density is designed for workloads that require hardware acceleration but do not demand the massive compute or memory footprints of newer GPU architectures. Suitable workloads include entry-level AI inference, video transcoding, lightweight 3D rendering, and GPU-assisted development or testing environments.
